remarks: Don't miss this amazing opportunity to rent in a sought-after neighborhood just a short walk from Hindley Elementary, Weed Beach, Great Island, restaurants, shopping, and the train station. This classic 4 BR, 3 BA Colonial, renovated in 2003, sits on a prime corner lot. The open eat-in kitchen features granite counters and a center island, connecting to the family room and formal dining room. The formal living room has a wood-burning fireplace, leading to a spacious great room with a custom wet bar and access to a side patio or year-round sunroom. The master suite includes French doors to a Juliet balcony, a spa tub, and a marble shower. Pet-friendly landlords and excellent walking trails complete the package.
